Field-teammate human body mesh
==============================

File: field_teammate_human_body.obj

Source: MakeHuman "hm08" base mesh (makehuman/data/3dobjs/base.obj)
        https://github.com/makehumancommunity/makehuman

License: CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication)
         https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

The MakeHuman base mesh was explicitly released to the public domain under
CC0 1.0 in September 2020 by Data Collection AB, Joel Palmius, and Jonas
Hauquier (see the header of the upstream base.obj and the MakeHuman
repository LICENSE.md, section C, "The base mesh and proxies").

CC0 imposes no attribution requirement; the credit above is provided as a
courtesy and for provenance.

Modifications from upstream:
  - Extracted only the visible "body" geometry group (dropped MakeHuman
    helper / rig / clothing cages and joint-marker cubes); vertex
    coordinates are unchanged.
  - Re-posed for HORUS via the URDF <origin> / <mesh scale> only (the .obj
    geometry itself is unmodified): MakeHuman is +Y up / faces +Z; the URDF
    rotates it to ROS +X-forward, +Z-up, feet at z=0, scaled to ~1.75 m.
